name: RADIATE — Radar Dataset in Adverse Weather
description: Automotive perception benchmark focusing on severe weather conditions, captured by Heriot-Watt University in the UK. Equipped with a Navtech CTS350-X 360-degree high-resolution scanning radar, a Quanergy M8 LiDAR, a ZED stereo camera, an infrared thermal camera, and GPS/IMU navigation sensors. Records driving sequences under dense fog, heavy snow, severe rain, and darkness, providing 43,800 labeled radar frames with bounding boxes for vehicles and pedestrians.
